$comment: The MCP servers the template can configure. /init writes .mcp.json from the entries whose capability the project selects, and adds each one's <package>@<version> to the project's root devDependencies as an exact version; pnpm mcp:docs reads this file to refresh the generated block of docs/mcp.md and to report pin bumps, and verify:mcp-docs holds the entries and the block to it. Each command is pinned and direct (decision 61): node runs the package's bin file, node_modules/<package>/<entry>, then the server's own arguments. That is one process per server instead of four (cmd.exe, conhost, the npx launcher and the server), no network fetch when a client starts it, and every version old enough for pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (1,440 minutes), which an unpinned npx -y bypasses.
